clues.text: On the Day of Atonement, Aaron laid both hands on a live one and sent it into the wilderness.
Joseph's brothers slaughtered one and dipped his robe in its blood before sending the robe to Jacob.
In a vision beside the Ulai Canal, one charged a two-horned ram and shattered both its horns.
In Jesus' parable, the older son complained that his father never gave him a young one to celebrate.
Gideon set a young one and unleavened bread on a rock, and fire flared up when the angel's staff touched them.
To fool Saul's messengers, Michal laid an idol in David's bed with this animal's hair on its head.
Jacob asked Laban for every speckled or spotted one of these, along with the dark lambs, as his wages.
